title: Comment cleanup: only Javadoc left, every private method documented
user-messages: create a new worktree for the comment cleanup and private methods javadocs

> about 85 |=/&= uses. Checkstyle can’t see types, so this rule can’t tell boolean |= from bitwise flag |=; it would have to ban both or guess.

ban both
description:
Clean up comments across Ixdar's Java sources so that the only comments left are Javadoc, ahead of checkstyle rules that will enforce it (in the autofix repo, a separate change).

## The target state

1. No `//` line comments, inside or outside method bodies. Full-line and end-of-line comments both go.
2. No `/* ... */` block comments that are not Javadoc.
3. Every private method has a Javadoc saying what it produces and its non-obvious invariant (Ixdar's Javadoc conventions apply: about 25 words, no restating the code).
4. Comments that carry information worth keeping are not lost: they move into the Javadoc of the method, field or class they explain, or are deleted when they restate the code. In particular, citations of ported third-party code (source repository URL and license, required by the third-party code rule) move into the Javadoc of the method that implements the port; about 96 full-line comments contain a URL or a license today (for example `Keys.java:14`, Apache 2.0).

## Scale (counted on master)

- About 2,900 full-line `//` comments in `ixdar-app/src/main` alone, plus end-of-line comments and test sources.
- About 1,600 private methods, many without Javadoc.

## Removing the full-line comments mechanically

The user's regex for full-line comments, keeping the citation lines for hand treatment:

    git ls-files -z '*.java' | xargs -0 perl -0pi -e 's{^[ \t]*//(?!.*(?:https?://|[Ll]icen[cs]e)).*\n}{}mg'

Read the comments before deleting them in bulk: a comment that explains a non-obvious invariant belongs in the Javadoc of its method, not in the bin. End-of-line comments need hand work, since `//` also appears inside strings such as URLs.

## Not in this ticket

- The checkstyle rules themselves (no line comments, Javadoc on private methods, no `|=` and `&=`, bitwise included): those live in the autofix repo and are a separate change.
- Behaviour changes: this is comments and Javadoc only; no code changes besides them.
definition-of-done:
1. `rg -n '//' --type java` over `ixdar-app/src` finds no comment (only `//` inside string literals remain), and no non-Javadoc `/* */` block comment remains.
2. Every private method in `ixdar-app/src/main` has a Javadoc; the checkstyle build still passes, JavadocDescriptionLength included.
3. Every third-party citation (source URL and license) that was a `//` comment now sits in the Javadoc of the method implementing the port.
4. No code changes besides comments and Javadoc: `git diff -w` shows only comment and Javadoc lines.
5. The full unit test suite passes, and a launch.json entry plus a screenshot under tmp/ show one scene still running.
6. The ticket lists any comment whose content was moved rather than deleted when it was not obvious where it belonged.
testing-plan: 1. Full unit suite. 2. rg for remaining // and /* comments. 3. git diff -w shows comment and Javadoc lines only. 4. One scene launched with a screenshot.
